data.name: Misbaahoon
data.gender_notes: Misbaahoon is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A source of guidance and enlightenment, a beacon that shines in the darkness. The name Misbaahoon carries the meaning “Guide, Lighthouse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Misbaahoon usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, lighthouse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and the path to spiritual enlightenment.
data.etymology: Misbaahoon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Lighthouse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misbaahoon total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: مصباحون
in_arabic.meaning: مصباحون تعني نور و روشنايي بخشنده
in_arabic.long_meaning: مصباحون اسم مؤنث است و از ریشه مصباح مشتق شده است. مصباح به معناي چراغ و منبع نور است. اين نام در فرهنگ اسلامی به كسي كه منبع نور و هدايت است اشاره دارد. در قرآن کريم نيز به نور و هدايت الهی اشاره شده است. مصباحون نامی است که براي دختران انتخاب می شود تا آنها را به نور و دانش و خردمندی تشویق کنند.

in_urdu.name: مصباحون
in_urdu.meaning: مصباحون کا مطلب ہے روشنی کا ذریعہ، نور بخش
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصباحون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے چراغ یا روشنی کا ذریعہ۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ نور اور ہدایت کی علامت ہے۔ اس نام کی انتخاب سے امید کی جاتی ہے کہ لڑکی نورانی صفات کے ساتھ ہوگی اور دکھوں میں دوسروں کی روشنی بنے گی۔

in_hindi.name: मिस्बाहून
in_hindi.meaning: मिस्बाहून का अर्थ है प्रकाश का स्रोत, दीपक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिस्बाहून एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है प्रकाश का स्रोत या दीपक। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम बच्चे के लिए एक प्रेरणा है कि वह दूसरों के लिए ज्ञान और सच्चाई की रोशनी बनें।

in_pashto.name: مصباحون
in_pashto.meaning: مصباحون د رڼا ورکونکی معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: مصباحون د ښځو یو نوم دی چی د مصباح څخه مشتق شوی دی. مصباح د څراغ معنی دی چی د نور او سپیناوی د سرچینې په توګه کارول کیږي. دا نوم داسې سړی ته اشاره کوي چی د نور او پوهې د ویشلو په برخه کی مثبت رول لوبوي.

in_english.name: Misbaahoon
in_english.long_meaning: Misbaahoon is a beautiful and meaningful name derived from the Arabic root 's-b-h' which means 'light'. In Islamic tradition, light symbolizes knowledge, guidance, and wisdom. The name Misbaahoon signifies a person who brings light, hope, and guidance to others, embodying the qualities of illumination and spiritual enlightenment.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Misbaahoon" is of Arabic origin, within Islamic culture, it is a compound name consisting of "Misbah" and "Aoon". A "Misbah" translates to a lamp or a light source, usually used for observation of prescribed religious practices such as Taraweeh and Tawaf, while "Aoon" translates to several, reverberating or resounding, and together it means "Many Lamps" or "Sources of Guidance and Enlightenment". This name holds significant cultural importance as it alludes to the importance of light and guidance in navigation, decision-making, and religious practices in Islamic communities. It is a reminder of the significance of knowledge, wisdom, and understanding as beacons that illuminate the path to a good life, and a rich and fulfilling spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Misbaahoon" holds remarkable spiritual significance within Islamic traditions, symbolizing the presence of divine guidance at all times, serving as a reminder of Allah's infinite love, mercy, and support. The many lamps or sources of guidance signify the immense knowledge and wisdom available to believers through their faith and religious practices. It is a call to seek guidance, to continuously learn and grow spiritually, and to understand that like a beacon in the night, Allah lights the way, leading the faithful to the truth and the path of righteousness. The name also signifies unity, solidarity, and a community of believers who unitedly follow the teachings of their faith, serving as a guiding light to each other and to future generations.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Lighthouse" symbolizes A source of guidance and enlightenment, a beacon that shines in the darkness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Misbaahoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, lighthouse.
